request: What impact did passing Obamacare have on the federal budget?

reply.reply: At enactment, CBO and JCT estimated the Affordable Care Act would reduce federal deficits by **$210 billion over FY2012–FY2021**. This was a projection, not a measure of what ultimately happened (CRS R41664, PDF p. 7). The estimate is historical, and the newest source verified here dates to 2012. Details and the distinction from revenue-only estimates are in the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261021-165546-6067.html).
reply.reasoning: A verified CRS finding directly answers the net budget-effect question. The brief labels the projection as enactment-era and cautions that it is not an actual subsequent budget outcome.
